quests.desc: Welcome to TextWorld! Here is how to play! First thing I need you to do is to pick up the rectangular key from the couch. After picking up the rectangular key, check that the rectangular locker within the recreation zone is unlocked with the rectangular key. And then, doublecheck that the rectangular locker is opened. Then, recover the Canadian style latchkey from the rectangular locker within the recreation zone. After that, unlock the Canadian style chest inside the recreation zone with the Canadian style latchkey. After that, make sure that the Canadian style chest is wide open. And then, retrieve the American limited edition keycard from the Canadian style chest inside the recreation zone. And then, assure that the American limited edition chest in the recreation zone is unlocked with the American limited edition keycard. Then, ensure that the American limited edition chest inside the recreation zone is open. Having opened the American limited edition chest, take the passkey from the American limited edition chest. After taking the passkey, make it so that the chest inside the recreation zone is unlocked with the passkey. And then, open the chest within the recreation zone. Got that? Good!

objective: Hey, thanks for coming over to the TextWorld today, there is something I need you to do for me. First off, if it's not too much trouble, I need you to retrieve the rectangular key from the couch. After getting the rectangular key, insert the rectangular key into the rectangular locker within the recreation zone's lock to unlock it. After that, open the rectangular locker in the recreation zone. After that, pick up the Canadian style latchkey from the rectangular locker inside the recreation zone. With the Canadian style latchkey, unlock the Canadian style chest within the recreation zone. And then, ensure that the Canadian style chest within the recreation zone is open. Then, pick up the American limited edition keycard from the Canadian style chest within the recreation zone. Then, make it so that the American limited edition chest is unlocked. Then, ensure that the American limited edition chest is open. If you have opened the American limited edition chest, retrieve the passkey from the American limited edition chest. After stealing the passkey, assure that the chest is unlocked. And then, assure that the chest inside the recreation zone is wide open. Alright, thanks!
